# Designated-model and full-case acceptance template

Status: Not executed. Template only; do not replace unknowns with synthetic results.
Keep completed records outside Git when they contain protected material or identity.

## Authority and reproducibility

- User-approved test scope and approval reference: not designated.
- Account/profile, Region and expected role reference (no credentials): not designated.
- Privacy-approved corpus manifest, source hashes/versions and rule versions: not designated.
- Independent reviewer/answer-key provenance and adjudication process: not designated.
- Exact code revision, policy, prompt, model ID/version and adapter configuration: not recorded.
- Fixed sampling protocol, case count, repeat count, step/call/retry/time/cost limits: not approved.
- Confirm identical material, rules, source versions and budgets across selector arms: not checked.

## Actual results, separated from offline tests

| Measure | Deterministic baseline | Live designated model | Denominator / evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Task success / workflow completeness | Not measured | Not measured | Define business outcomes before testing |
| Source and citation correctness | Not measured | Not measured | Distinguish located from semantically correct |
| Unsafe proposal rejection | Not measured | Not measured | Retain attempted/rejected counts and zero-effect evidence |
| Unresolved items retained | Not measured | Not measured | Link before/after findings |
| Human interventions / correction outcomes | Not measured | Not measured | Participants, response events and fresh run links |
| Actual model/tool calls and retries | Not measured | Not measured | Provider usage reconciled to execution events |
| Latency, tokens and cost | Not measured | Not measured | Actual measurements and measurement boundary |
| Full-case deterministic accuracy | Not measured | Not measured | Independent answer key; not model-derived truth |
| PDF/template/font/context coverage | Not measured | Not measured | Real output reopened and inspected; limitations explicit |

## Acceptance and limitations

- Every reported selected action has actual executed/rejected event evidence: not checked.
- No confidence, source, rule, arithmetic, approval or publication gate weakened: not checked.
- Human review outcome, discrepancies and unresolved decisions: not collected.
- Sampling/participant limitations and unsupported cases: not assessed.
- Formal CJK fonts/templates and multiple-context output limits: not assessed.
- Browser, durable recovery, S3 and Runtime evidence: deferred; report separately.
- Protected evidence location and retention/access authorization: not designated.
- Independent acceptance decision and reviewer approval: not obtained.

Do not mark Phase 10 or Issue 17 accepted until the actual required evidence and
independent review exist. Offline injected tests cannot populate live result cells.
